name: _parseAIMarkers: 3 occurrences → 3 parsed markers with sequential positions
description: Verifies the AI-marker parser: when the AI wraps 3 occurrences of the same term (using the SAME enRaw each time), _parseAIMarkers returns 3 entries in document order. This is the input contract for the LỚP 1/2 pipeline.
sourceText: The witness saw the witness. The witness left.
vnMarked: Nhân chứng đã thấy [[H:witness]]nhân chứng[[/H]]. [[H:witness]]Nhân chứng[[/H]] đã rời đi.

name: _parseAIMarkers: VN word-order swap (paradox of progress → nghịch lý của tiến bộ)
description: Verifies the parser accepts a multi-word phrase whose Vietnamese counterpart has swapped word order — the entire vn span must be extracted as a single string.
sourceText: The paradox of progress is striking.
vnMarked: Điều [[H:paradox of progress]]nghịch lý của tiến bộ[[/H]] thật đáng chú ý.
regressGuard: tiếng Việt dịch đơn lẻ độc lập

name: _parseAIMarkers: trailing comma in vn span still parses cleanly
description: Verifies the parser tolerates a trailing comma inside the [[H:...]]...[[/H]] vn span (Vietnamese-style punctuation).
regressGuard: parser fails when vn span contains trailing comma

name: _parseAIMarkers: vn span inside parentheses parses cleanly
description: Verifies the parser extracts vn even when wrapped in ( ) parens — the marker regex is greedy enough to capture the content but stops at the first [[/H]].

name: _parseAIMarkers: full multi-word phrase vn span parses atomically
description: Verifies the parser returns ONE marker for a multi-word phrase (not split into fragments).
vnMarked: Điều [[H:paradox of progress]]nghịch lý của tiến bộ[[/H]] nổi bật.
regressGuard: multi-word phrase gets split into fragments

name: _parseAIMarkers: 2 separate vn spans for same enRaw — both parsed
description: Verifies the parser returns 2 markers when the AI wraps only 'nghịch lý' and 'tiến bộ' separately (PASS 2.5/2.6 chain-merge happens at a higher layer; the parser just reports both markers raw).
sourceText: The paradox of progress is striking.
vnMarked: Điều [[H:paradox of progress]]nghịch lý[[/H]] của sự [[H:paradox of progress]]tiến bộ[[/H]] thật đáng chú ý.

vocabList.translatedTermInVN: nghịch lý của sự tiến bộ

regressGuard: parser misses one of the 2 split markers

name: _validateAndRepairMarkers: detects exactly 1 missing key when AI forgets 1 of 3
description: Verifies the validate contract: given 3 highlight keys but only 2 AI markers, validate returns the missing enKey in `missingEnKeys`. This is the INPUT CONTRACT for the retry-patch pass — `app.handleTranslate()` uses this list to feed `translator.repairMissingMarkers()` with ONLY the missing keys.
sourceText: Witness, progress, and paradigm walked in.
vnMarked: [[H:witness]]Nhân chứng[[/H]] và [[H:progress]]tiến bộ[[/H]] đã bước vào.
regressGuard: retry không filter theo từ thiếu

name: _stitchMissingPatches: inserts new markers WITHOUT duplicating existing ones
description: Verifies the retry stitcher in isolation: patches whose vn lives INSIDE an existing [[H:…]]…[[/H]] span must be rejected (no double-wrap); patches for new vn spans must be stitched in the FIRST plain segment where they occur.
sourceText: Witness, progress, and a paradigm shift today.
vnMarked: [[H:witness]]Nhân chứng[[/H]] và [[H:progress]]tiến bộ[[/H]]. Một paradigm shift cũng xuất hiện hôm nay.
regressGuard: retry patch duplicate hoặc bỏ sót từ

name: _stitchMissingPatches: per-patch verified flag is forwarded into the new token
description: Verifies the verified=true/false flag on a patch gets serialized into the [[H:key|1]] / [[H:key|0]] token — which the parser then maps to ai-verified / ai-retried. Without this, LỚP 2 would lose the per-marker confidence info for retry-stitched marks.
sourceText: Witness, progress, and a paradigm shift today.
vnMarked: [[H:witness]]Nhân chứng[[/H]] và [[H:progress]]tiến bộ[[/H]]. Một paradigm shift cũng xuất hiện hôm nay.
regressGuard: verified flag bị mất → không tag ai-retried được

name: _computeTranslatedHTML: VN output is plain escaped paragraphs (no <mark> elements)
description:
Per user request (Aug 1 2026): the Vietnamese translation panel shows ONLY plain translated text. No highlights, no colored marks, no elements on the VN side. Only the English side retains highlighting. The renderer must split paragraphs, NFC-normalize, escape HTML, and wrap each paragraph in

.
vnMarked: [[H:witness]]Nhân chứng[[/H]] và [[H:progress]]tiến bộ[[/H]]. paradigm shift xuất hiện hôm nay, mang lại khả năng phục hồi.
regressGuard: VN side hiển thị mark — sai yêu cầu user

name: _computeTranslatedHTML: VN output HTML-escapes special characters in vn text
description: Verifies the plain-text renderer still HTML-escapes the vn text (so a malicious or accidentally-included <script> tag in the AI's translated text doesn't break the page). The tags [[H:...]]...[[/H]] are stripped, the inner text is escaped.
regressGuard: không escape HTML → XSS / trang vỡ
